vision.name: Assisted Galick Gun
vision.text:
([Trait:Earthling] and 2 or less Traits only.)
[Attack] 2: Energy attack.
Raise your anger 1. If your MP has [Trait:Saiyan] and you stopped an attack on your opponent's last action this combat, your opponent passes for their next action this combat.
DAMAGE: 5 life cards.
HIT: Use a critical damage effect.
(Banish after use.)
vision.note: grey card; icons zoomed: blue Capsule Corp E badge (Earthling) and green S badge (Saiyan); stage cost printed as '2:'; no Endurance badge
